player_prompt.intro:
Uri kudzana Mastermind.
Unoda kupata code iri {code_length} digits refu, kubva 1 hadi {num_numbers}, {repeats}.
Mujowo unopinda, unoweza kuwasamura guess yako kwenye fomati inotevera: '[2 1 4 5]'.
Pasirese guess, unopota kupokea feedback muform ya black na white pegs.
Black peg inaonyesha digit sahihi katika nafasi sahihi, wakati white peg inaonyesha digit sahihi katika nafasi isiyo sahihi.
Unayo {max_turns} mavara kupamba code.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Hauna kupindura norunyorwa rwemazita akaparadzaniswa nenhamba dzakaputirwa mumabhuraketi akakwana.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Nhamba dzose dzinofanira kuva pakati pe1 ne {num_numbers}.
invalid_move.repeated_guess: Watofungidzira {guess}. Ndapota edza imwe fungidziro yakasiyana.

game_action.feedback: Wakaisa [{guess}]. Maererano: {black_pegs} piki nhema, {white_pegs} piki nyeupe.

outcome.win: Wakabata sanduku, ukapata {black_pegs} kubva {code_length} tsvimbo zvakanaka
outcome.turn_limit: Muganhu wokutendeuka wasvika. Wafungidzira {percent} muzana yenhamba zvakarurama.
